desc:
🍦 Roll Ice Cream! 🍦

Make your own rolled ice cream and become the sweetest shop around!

🥛 Pour, chop, spread and roll. Pour milk on the frozen pan, mix in your ingredients, then scrape it into perfect rolls!

🧊 Open fridges. Place fridges on your plot and open them to roll for ingredients. There are 100 to find, from Strawberries to cosmic, one-in-a-billion treats!

🍓 Sweeter is better. Rarer ingredients make sweeter ice cream, and sweeter ice cream is worth more money.

🎡 Spin the wheel. After every ice cream, spin for a multiplier of up to x100!

😋 Eat it to cash in. Use your money on better fridges, scrapers, milk cartons, luck totems and more.

📖 Fill your Index. Discover every ingredient and all 20 fridges for bonus money.

👥 Play with friends. Each friend in your server boosts your money!

🎁 Daily rewards and offline earnings keep the cash rolling even when you're away.

How rare can you go? 🍨
